source.shortDescription1:
Waye' is a 40,364 sqft complex based on a mindfulness concept, 

Located in Tulum District, with 60 units consisting of 12 studios, 24 one-bedroom, and 24 two-bedroom apartments distributed in 4 four-story buildings. It has common area amenities such as a lobby, reception, green areas, infinity pool, coworking area, family room, gym, trails, and underground parking.

es.shortDescription1:
Waye' es un complejo de 40,364 pies cuadrados basado en un concepto de atención plena.

Ubicado en Tulum District, cuenta con 60 unidades: 12 estudios, 24 departamentos de una recámara y 24 de dos recámaras, distribuidos en 4 edificios de cuatro pisos. Sus amenidades comunes incluyen lobby, recepción, áreas verdes, alberca infinita, área de coworking, sala familiar, gimnasio, senderos y estacionamiento subterráneo.

Oxygen Residences is one of the most centrally located and brand-new condominium developments in Playa del Carmen. 

Completed in 2024. It is located on 5th avenue and 42 street, the neighborhood’s main commercial thoroughfare brimming with restaurants, specialty shops, and more.

Terminado en 2024, se ubica en la Quinta Avenida y la calle 42, en la principal vía comercial de la colonia, llena de restaurantes, tiendas especializadas y mucho más.
